{{Quote|Are you going to make this hard or easy?|Unidentified female Rutanian police to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="TSP" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutanian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]]. Sometime in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], she served as a [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Testa]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the [[Senali (species)|Senali]] [[Drenna]], tried to get themselves arrested by illegally loitering on a park, this female police and her [[Unidentified male Rutanian police|partner]] intervened. Tired, and anxious to go home, the two police officers gave them a warning instead. Qui-Gon then resorted to [[Mind trick/Legends|influencing]] the female police's mind with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and planted the suggestion that the three of them needed to be arrested.<ref name="TSP" />
